item.title: Attrangi unveils Almaaz: A symphony of light and elegance in jewellery
item.description: Attrangi introduces Almaaz, a jewellery collection that embodies a symphony of light and elegance. Co-founders Vidushi Jain and Saloni Shah have crafted pieces that merge ethereal luminosity with cultural heritage, using a proprietary technique to mimic fine diamonds. The collection features sculpted diamonds and contemporary designs, offering a radiant yet refined aesthetic for the modern woman.

item.title: Crafting calm: The Burma Edit’s celebration of Burmese rattan & intentional design

item.title: Kaseeda’s Cres’h collection elevates holiday luxury with craftsmanship
item.description: Kaseeda's Cres’h collection redefines holiday luxury with its focus on craftsmanship and design. The collection, curated by founder Kirti Seth, features sculptural bags that blend couture-inspired textures with a refined winter palette. Each piece is crafted with precision, offering festive versatility and timeless appeal, making them ideal for gifting and celebrating the season in style.
